explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 64 named tracks and releases across Juno's 75-release current techno field, an emerging Umay/remix-contest and adjacent club window, and an overlooked electro/techno catalogue window. Written exact-track and attributed release descriptions only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno's September 7–13 techno listings, with exact current pages for COW, Alexander Kowalski remixers, PS11 and VVAA008. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/this-week/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Umay newcomer COW, student-remix entrant GZI, and TraTraTrax's current cross-regional club sampler. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/cow-open-the-closed-vinyl/1170190-01/ ; https://www.juno.co.uk/products/alexander-kowalski-sinee-remixes-vinyl/1172004-01/ ; https://www.juno.co.uk/products/maoupa-mazzocchetti-wost-anthony-los-totes-vol-3-vinyl/1174563-01/
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Juno's electro back catalogue, including 710 Exit, Acid Jesus and 50DIX. https://www.juno.co.uk/electro/back-cat/
exclusions: Completed Runs 209–213 source fields and ranked identities, failed Run 212 identities, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (208, 209, 210, 211 and 213). None of the nine primary placements repeats their selected-candidate boundaries; failed Run 212 boundaries were also avoided.

Nine honest leads survived with concrete source evidence, constitution-relevant belonging hypotheses and adjacent current-ledger URI pairs. Ranking balances current, emerging/adjacent and overlooked catalogue information gain without imposing a quota.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
